blocks.en: An Existence Proof for the Dirichlet Problem
blocks.zh: Dirichlet 问题的一个存在性证明
blocks.label: sec:dirichlet-existence-proof

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: In this section, we shall establish existence of solutions for the Dirichlet problem. Specifically, we shall prove the following theorem:
blocks.zh: 本节将证明 Dirichlet 问题解的存在性. 具体地说, 将证明以下定理:

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $\Omega$ be a bounded domain in $\mathbb{R}^n$ with a $C^2$-boundary. Then, for any function $g\in C(\partial\Omega)$, there is a unique $u\in C^2(\Omega)\cap C(\overline\Omega)$ satisfying $\Delta u=0$ in $\Omega$ and $u=g$ on $\partial\Omega$.
blocks.zh: 设 $\Omega$ 为 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 中具有 $C^2$ 边界的有界区域. 那么对任意函数 $g\in C(\partial\Omega)$, 都存在唯一的 $u\in C^2(\Omega)\cap C(\overline\Omega)$, 满足在 $\Omega$ 内 $\Delta u=0$, 且在 $\partial\Omega$ 上 $u=g$.
blocks.label: thm:dirichlet-continuous-data-existence

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: It will be evident from the proof that the assumption that $\partial\Omega$ is of class $C^2$ can be relaxed; for example, all convex domains are permissible.
blocks.zh: 从证明中将清楚看到, $\partial\Omega$ 属于 $C^2$ 类这一假设可以放宽; 例如, 所有凸区域都是允许的.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The proof will be based on the ideas of Perron, which make use of the following notions. We call $v$ a subsolution (supersolution) if $\Delta v\geq0$ ($\Delta v\leq0$) in $\Omega$ and $v\leq g$ ($v\geq g$) on $\partial\Omega$. Obviously subsolutions exist, e.g., every sufficiently small constant is a subsolution. The maximum principle (weak form) shows that if $u$ is a solution, then $v\leq u$ for every subsolution (this is why we call them subsolutions). Thus, the pointwise supremum of all subsolutions (which is a well defined function) gives us an obvious candidate for a solution. If we can show that this function actually solves the problem, our existence proof will be complete. Before we prove this, we first need to develop a number of prerequisites.
blocks.zh: 证明基于 Perron 的思想, 利用以下概念. 若在 $\Omega$ 内 $\Delta v\geq0$ ($\Delta v\leq0$), 且在 $\partial\Omega$ 上 $v\leq g$ ($v\geq g$), 则称 $v$ 为下解 (上解). 显然下解存在, 例如每个足够小的常数都是下解. 最大值原理 (弱形式) 表明, 若 $u$ 为解, 则对每个下解都有 $v\leq u$ (这正是称其为下解的原因). 因此, 所有下解的逐点上确界 (这是一个良定义的函数) 给出一个显然的候选解. 若能证明这个函数确实解该问题, 存在性证明就完成了. 在证明这一点之前, 先需要发展一些预备知识.

blocks.en: The Dirichlet Problem on a Ball
blocks.label: subsec:dirichlet-problem-on-ball

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The most old-fashioned way to prove existence of solutions is to give a formula for them. (We discussed some elementary methods for doing this in Section~\ref{subsec:laplace-equation}.) We now obtain an explicit solution for the Dirichlet problem on a ball.
blocks.zh: 证明解存在的最传统方法就是给出解的公式. (Section~\ref{subsec:laplace-equation} 中讨论过一些实现这一点的初等方法.) 现在求出球上 Dirichlet 问题的显式解.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.label: thm:poisson-ball-formula

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Equation \eqref{eq:poisson-ball-solution-formula} is known as Poisson\textquotesingle s formula. We note that the special case $\bm{x}=0$ leads to the well known mean-value property: The value of a harmonic function at a point is equal to its average on any ball centered at that point.
blocks.zh: 方程 \eqref{eq:poisson-ball-solution-formula} 称为 Poisson 公式. 注意, 特殊情形 $\bm{x}=0$ 导出众所周知的平均值性质: 调和函数在某点的值等于它在以该点为球心的任意球上的平均值.
